prompt: From the high vantage the camera tilts gently and begins to glide forward over the course. The row of horses stands ready at the long stalls; then all the front gates fly open in the same instant and every horse leaps out together, the field staying in one even line as it gallops along the striped turf between the white rails, coloured caps level across the whole width. The camera follows the line as it rolls away into the drifting fog. Sound: a single metal crash, a wave of hooves on soft ground, rain, a far-off crowd roar, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
